<a name="File"></a>
## type File

File is one manifest entry: a file name with its expected digest and size.

```go
type File struct {
    Name   string
    SHA256 string
    Size   int64
}
```

<a name="Manifest"></a>
## type Manifest

Manifest lists the files of a model and the URL prefix they resolve from.

```go
type Manifest struct {
    BaseURL string
    Files   []File
}
```

<a name="Pinned"></a>
### func Pinned

```go
func Pinned() Manifest
```

Pinned returns the manifest of the model Takt ships.

<a name="Manifest.Acquire"></a>
### func \(Manifest\) Acquire

```go
func (m Manifest) Acquire(ctx context.Context, client *http.Client, dir string) error
```

Acquire downloads every manifest file into dir. Each download is capped at its manifest size, verified against its SHA\-256, and written atomically.

<a name="Model"></a>
## type Model

Model is a loaded static embedding model. It is read\-only and safe for concurrent use.

```go
type Model struct {
    // contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

<a name="Load"></a>
### func Load

```go
func Load(dir string) (*Model, error)
```

Load reads the model files from dir, rejecting any that do not form a coherent model.

<a name="Model.Embed"></a>
### func \(\*Model\) Embed

```go
func (m *Model) Embed(text string) []float32
```

Embed returns the unit\-length mean of the text's token vectors, or the zero vector when no token remains, exactly as the Model2Vec reference does.
